title: Iowa Speedway I iRacing Pro Track Guide by TCSP I NASCAR O'Reilly Series

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: judge distance to new pavement, feel of car during braking
corners.mistakes: not having markers or cones to judge turn radius

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake gently to stabilize entry, use limited brake pressure
corners.line: turn-in to new pavement, aim for tighter option to reduce splitter contact
corners.mistakes: using too much brake pressure, being too abrupt away from the wall

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Brake to Iowa turn one signage, light above red paint.
corners.line: Turn-in to start apex, limited brake pressure.
corners.mistakes: Too much braking or wheel shaping can cause a free trend.

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: Off brake at signage on inside wall.
corners.exit: Maintain angle of apex, ramp up to 100% throttle.
corners.mistakes: Overcommitting, too shallow entry, destabilized entry.

corners.label: T2
corners.line: Stay on painted line to apex, then center of track
corners.exit: Maintain throttle to hold apex, ramp up to 100% throttle
corners.mistakes: Pushing tight with the nose, opening the wheel too early

corners.label: T2
corners.exit: Keep left side tires just below this point on exit.
corners.mistakes: Adding too much wheel angle too early on exit can cost speed and lap time.

corners.label: T3
corners.line: turn before I in Iowa, set up for lift point
corners.mistakes: don't get to painted line too early

corners.braking: Limited brake pressure, do not get to painted line too early.
corners.line: Get to painted line lower exit.
corners.mistakes: Slipping the right rear when crossing to old pavement near restart zone.

corners.line: cross into the banking with right side tires
corners.exit: throttle 100%, counter steer, then steer left to guide into banking
corners.mistakes: pushing tight, crossing seam too early, adding more wheel shape with older tires

corners.label: T1
corners.line: Run higher in the second groove on restart

corners.braking: braking point, get off the brake

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: limited brake pressure, trail off closer to compression point
corners.mistakes: more brake pressure leads to front end pushing and going off line

corners.line: keep the radius of the apex
corners.exit: ramp up to 100% throttle when I know I can open the exit up
corners.mistakes: crossing the seam too early, exiting the wall too high

corners.exit: lower ramp up the throttle and steady increase the throttle

corners.braking: Brake about a car length and a half to two before braking marker
corners.gear: Downshift to third, second while on the racetrack
corners.line: Cut early, keep trajectory, avoid carrying too much speed
corners.exit: Approach smoothly, get closer to the wall
corners.mistakes: Carrying too much speed, causing a slide near the pit barrels

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: higher entry, straighten approach, more braking pressure
corners.mistakes: too much braking pressure, getting loose on entry
